meta.name: autonomous-investigation
meta.description: The protocol behind every investigation skill. Use when AI research must proceed without you: search-plan gate, Fact/Inference/Assumption labels, confidence stacking, diffable outputs.

copy.tagline: 让AI研究自动进行，无需人工介入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要AI自主完成多步骤调研并输出结构化结果
copy.tagline_en: Let AI research proceed without manual intervention
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to autonomously conduct multi-step research and output structured results

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照一套固定流程自主进行网络调研：先展示搜索计划，然后搜索、标注每条关键证据为事实/推断/假设，最后给出4个后续选项。输出结构每次一致，方便对比前后变化。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude对某个主题进行自主调研，且不打算一步步指导它时触发。例如你说“调研一下X公司的市场动向”或“帮我做一份竞争分析”。

say.text: 调研一下DeepSeek最近的产品发布，支持我们Q3的路线图决策。
say.note: Claude会展示搜索计划，然后开始调研。

say.text: 帮我做一份竞争对手的季度扫描，输出要能跟上次对比。
say.note: Claude会按固定结构输出，方便对比变化。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a fixed protocol for autonomous web research: it shows a search plan, then searches, labels each key claim as Fact/Inference/Assumption, and ends with 4 next-step options. Output structure is stable across runs for easy diffing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to research a topic autonomously without step-by-step guidance. For example, "Research company X's market moves" or "Do a competitive scan."

say_en.text: Investigate DeepSeek's recent product launches to support our Q3 roadmap decision.
say_en.note: Claude will show a search plan and then start researching.

say_en.text: Run a quarterly competitive scan with output comparable to last time.
say_en.note: Claude will output in a fixed schema for easy diffing.
